description_for_human: Find the best restaurants, cafes, bars, and attractions in any city — curated from Reddit with Google ratings, insider tips, and what to order.
description_for_model: Search tabiji.ai for free AI-curated travel data. The API covers: 6,488 destinations (cities, regions, countries) with budget ratings ($–$$$$), best seasons, vibes, and travel styles; 467 restaurant/bar/cafe/attraction picks guides covering 5,429 curated places with Google ratings, opening hours, Reddit quotes, insider tips, and 'what to order' advice; 443 day-by-day travel itineraries with neighborhoods and activity breakdowns; 925 destination comparisons with category-by-category analysis, Reddit quotes, and verdicts; 250 countries with capitals, population, currencies, languages, and factual metadata. Use the unified search endpoint (GET /api/v1/search-index.json) to find slugs by keyword, then follow each item's `url` field. Destinations and itineraries have JSON detail endpoints (/api/v1/destinations/{slug}.json, /api/v1/itineraries/{slug}.json). Picks and comparisons have canonical HTML pages (https://tabiji.ai/popular-picks/{slug}/, https://tabiji.ai/compare/{slug}/) — per-slug JSON for those collections was retired 2026-04-20. Destination records include relatedPicks, relatedItineraries, and relatedComparisons for cross-linking. All data is editorially curated from Reddit and verified with Google Places. No API key required. CORS is fully open.
